# std.env

Process environment.

## Types

### `Vars`

```badger
struct Vars { names: List<String> }
```

Read access to the named environment variables, and no others: a
capability the entry module of a restricted project can hand out.

#### `Vars.get`

```badger
fn get(self: &Self, name: String) -> Option<String> !{Io}
```

The variable's value; `none` for a name this capability does not
cover, as for one that is not set.
